description_full: Zeta Global Holdings Corp. operates an omnichannel data-driven cloud platform that provides enterprises with consumer intelligence and marketing automation software in the United States and internationally. The company operates Zeta Marketing platform, a single platform that enable enterprises to acquire, grow, and retain consumer relationships efficiently and effectively than alternative solutions; and Zeta Messaging, an email service provider, offering end-to-end AI-powered omnichannel messaging capabilities, as well as integrated data management, enterprise-scale delivery and support, and sophisticated omnichannel orchestration. In addition, the company offers Zeta Consumer Data platform (CDP+), a system of record for consumer information, delivers a single, actionable view of customers and prospects that include real-time identifiers and signals, and other key attributes; and Zeta's DSP for customers to maximize the power of paid media to engage the right audiences with precision and efficiency, as well as delivers experiences via desktop, inbox, mobile, CTV and social, and others. Further, it operates Athena by Zeta, an interface to Zeta's AI-native infrastructure layer and intends to power all intelligent decisioning, automation, and user interaction; and Zeta Answers that synthesize trillions of behavioral signals into intent-based scores tied to a unique individual. The company has a strategic partnership with Palantir Technologies Inc. for the development of enterprise AI infrastructure layer that connects operational intelligence, customer intelligence, and marketing execution. Zeta Global Holdings Corp. has a strategic alliance with Fireworks.ai, Inc. to develop the Athena Inference Model (AIM), a collection of specialized open-weight models powering AthenaOS, to help customers generate insights faster, improve efficiency and scale specialized AI across the enterprise. The company was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in New York, New York.

The top line has compounded at +30% over the past three years, the kind of sustained demand persistence that marks a compounder. Operating margins are expanding by +13.7pp year-over-year, which is one of the strongest signals that the moat is deepening.
Returns on capital run at -79% against a 11% cost of capital, which means the business is destroying value with every dollar it reinvests.
The business throws off $185M in free cash flow — roughly 14 cents on every revenue dollar, which is the owner-earnings figure that actually belongs to shareholders.
On the balance sheet, the balance sheet carries net cash, which is the gold standard: the business never has to make desperate decisions in a bad year, and interest coverage of 14× is fortress-like.

Shareholder yield is only 0.0%, a thin return of capital, and stock-based comp at 14% of revenue is silent dilution an owner has to account for, and insider ownership is negligible, so management has little personal stake in the long-term outcome, and profit capture is only 0.0× the fair share, suggesting no structural edge inside its industry.
